scope.generality: geometric fibres of a balanced genus-six degree-four CE family satisfying the weak relative-canonical normalization

finding.statement: On a balanced fibre satisfying the weak CE normalization, h^0(L) = 3 (this lemma) combines with base-point-freeness of L on the balanced locus to make the general member of |L| ≅ P^2 consist of six DISTINCT points, hence the reduced-support open of the closed Abel–Jacobi incidence is nonempty and dense in every fibre of the P^2-bundle. Argument: if L had a base point p, then L(-p) would be a g^2_5 on a genus-six curve, forcing a smooth plane quintic, whose tetragonal pencil is projection from that point and is CE-unbalanced, hence excluded from the balanced locus; L base-point-free with h^0 = 3 gives a finite morphism φ_L : C → P^2 whose image spans, and in characteristic zero φ_L is separable onto its image, so a general line pulls back to a reduced divisor (Bertini), i.e. six distinct points.
